description.zh: 要添加到防护对象组中的防护对象。多个防护对象之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。该参数为空，表示防护对象组不添加任何防护对象。
description.en: The protected objects to add to the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). If this parameter is empty, no protected objects are added to the protected object group.

description.zh: 要从防护对象组中删除的防护对象。多个防护对象之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。该参数为空，表示不从防护对象组中删除任何防护对象。
description.en: The protected objects to remove from the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). If this parameter is empty, no protected objects are removed from the protected object group.

description.zh: 防护对象组描述信息。最大支持512个字符。
description.en: The description of the protected object group. The description can be up to 512 characters long.

description.zh: 要修改的防护对象组名称。
description.en: The name of the protected object group to modify.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is located. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-resource-group --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --group-name test01 --add-list test1.aliyundoc.com,test2.aliyundoc.com --delete-list test14.waf.com,test24.waf.com --description test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyDefenseResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test01 --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --AddList 'test1.aliyundoc.com,test2.aliyundoc.com' --DeleteList 'test14.waf.com,test24.waf.com' --Description test --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
